definitions.explanation: A small, cylindrical charcoal cooking brazier traditionally made of diatomaceous earth ({珪藻土|けいそうど}). Used in homes and restaurants for grilling fish, meat, and vegetables one piece at a time.

examples.japanese: {七輪|しちりん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{秋刀魚|さんま}→秋刀魚：13756_sanma⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焼|や}いた→焼く：01123_yaku⟧。
examples.english: I grilled saury on a shichirin.
At this restaurant you grill the meat yourself on a shichirin.

examples.japanese: ⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{七輪|しちりん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧や⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焼|や}いて→焼く：01123_yaku⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんだ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: We brought the shichirin out into the garden and had fun grilling fish and vegetables as a family.

notes:
Said to come from the older practice of selling enough charcoal for one use at the price of {七厘|しちりん} (seven rin, a tiny denomination). The diatomaceous-earth body insulates the heat well, allowing strong grilling with little fuel.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {七輪|しちりん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧: to grill on a shichirin
- {七輪|しちりん}{焼|や}き: shichirin-grilled (dish style)
- ⟦{炭|すみ}→炭：13375_sumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{七輪|しちりん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put charcoal in the shichirin

CULTURAL NOTE:
Long associated with home cooking of grilled fish (⟦{秋刀魚|さんま}→秋刀魚：13756_sanma⟧, {鯵|あじ}) and now also popular in {焼|やき}{鳥|とり} and ⟦{焼|やき}{肉|にく}→焼肉：04984_yakiniku⟧ restaurants that serve a personal grill per table.
